newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: At least six killed in South Korean pile-up.
newsitem.headline: At least six killed in South Korean pile-up.

text.p: At least six people were killed and 26 injured on Thursday in a highway pile-up involving a passenger bus, two trucks and three cars, police said.

The accident occured in the early hours near the central city of Chonan on a highway linking Seoul with the southern city of Pusan. Police said the bus was carrying about 28 people and were investigating the cause of the pile-up.
